subject: Request: admin activity evidence & export options for SOC2 review - Vanguard Pharm
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@vanguardpharm.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: audit@vanguardpharm.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin activity evidence & export options for SOC2 review

Hi Aditya,

We're kicking off a SOC 2 readiness review at Vanguard Pharm and our compliance team needs examples of the admin activity logging we can expect from Redwood (what's captured, retention, export formats, and transfer options). Specifically we'd like: 
- A short inventory of admin events (privileged role changes, API key operations, console sign-ins, config changes, role delegation) and the fields included (timestamp, actor, IP, action, target, request id).
- Retention windows you support today and options for on-demand snapshots.
- Export formats (CSV/JSON/Parquet), manifest/checksum support, and preferred secure transfer methods (SFTP, presigned S3, FTPS).
- Any SOC 2 / SIG wording we can reuse in our control narratives.

Could you send a short sample manifest and an example extract (anonymized) covering a 30-day window? Also let me know if a non-disclosure MOU or a secure intake procedure is required before we share account IDs.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Director, Compliance Operations
Vanguard Pharm

----
Note: please copy compliance@vanguardpharm.com for records.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@vanguardpharm.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence & export options for SOC2 review

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Tagging Kimberly (security & compliance) and Karthik (ops) to help with the extract.

Short answers up front:
- Event types: admin sign-ins, console actions (create/delete roles, change permissions), API key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke), policy changes, model deployment events, operator sessions, and data-access admin operations are captured. Each entry includes: UTC timestamp, user id (internal id + email if available), source IP, action verb, resource type, resource id, request_id/trace_id, and optional metadata (role_before/after, reason).
- Retention: default admin activity retention is 180 days for hosted accounts, configurable up to 3 years on Dedicated/Private contracts. We support ad-hoc snapshots for procurement/audits with attested manifests.
- Exports: CSV and newline-delimited JSON for row-based exports; Parquet for bulk/archival exports. Exports include a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums), event count, and earliest/latest timestamps.
- Transfer: we can deliver via SFTP (our preferred for longer-term handoffs), presigned S3 links (time-limited), or a secure scp drop. All transfers can be encrypted and come with a signed manifest.

I attached a short sample manifest (redwood_admin_activity_manifest_v1.csv) and a 72-hour anonymized extract (redwood_admin_activity_sample_report.pdf) to illustrate fields and structure. We usually require a one-page MOU for initial on-prem/third-party ingest or we can exchange a quick Docusign MOU — happy to do either.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm timeframe and preferred transfer method.
2) We prepare a 30-day anonymized snapshot and submit it with manifest and checksum.
3) If you need production-level export, we can schedule an on-demand snapshot — we typically ask for 48–72 hours lead time.

If you want a short control narrative snippet for SOC2/SIG, I can draft one for you.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_admin_activity_manifest_v1.csv, redwood_admin_activity_sample_report.pdf

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@vanguardpharm.com>

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications: 
- Timezone: our auditors expect UTC timestamps in the extract (preferred).
- Sampling window: let's start with a 30-day window (2026-10-15 through 2026-11-14) for the anonymized sample.
- Transfer: SFTP is fine for the sample; for production evidence bundle we will likely request presigned S3 with bucket logging enabled on our side.

We can sign an MOU via DocuSign. Can you also confirm whether user identifiers are pseudonymized in the anonymized sample and whether IPs are redacted (we need redacted IPs in the example, full IPs allowed in production-only deliveries under NDA).

Appreciate quick turnaround — our SOC window is tight.

Olivia

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800

Kimberly / Karthik — FYI, Vanguard Pharm would like a 30-day anonymized sample (15 Oct - 14 Nov). They want UTC timestamps and redacted IPs for the sample (full IPs allowed in production under NDA). SFTP ok for sample; presigned S3 for prod. Attachments I already sent: manifest + sample.

Operational notes / recommended approach: 
- Prepare a snapshot job with pseudonymization applied to user identifiers (hash + salt) and redact IPs in the sample. Keep a mapping matrix locally in case of legal request (mapping requires enterprise approval and a signed MOU).
- Export format: NDJSON for the snapshot (easy for the auditors to ingest) + Parquet for archive. Include manifest.csv with sha256 checksums and an attestation statement signed by Redwood security.
- Retention ask: confirm that Vanguard's procurement can request a 3-year retention add-on if they need it; default is 180 days for hosted. Pricing/legal will need to sign off on any retention extension.

Karthik — can you estimate lead time for a 30-day pseudonymized NDJSON export and a signed manifest?

Thanks,
Aditya
